conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: What if I tell you that you don’t need to lie now?
Police: What if I tell you that your lie is a bad lie and will hurt Auntie and Xiyuan even more?
Respondent: Why is it a bad lie if I don’t say anything?
Respondent: If I say it...
Respondent: If I tell the truth...
Respondent: It will make Auntie look like a bad person.
Respondent: But Auntie is a good person.
Respondent: Actually, it’s because of me...
Respondent: It’s all my fault.
